what: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
title: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: actisleep estimates sleep wrist-worn accelerometry. provides sleep-period-time (SPT) guiders, sustained-inactivity-bout (SIB) labels, consensus sleep labels, diary helpers, wrappers asleep sleeper machine-learning models. guider functions identify likely main sleep window. Combine one guiders SIB label epoch-level sleep/wake label needed.

title: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: Install development version GitHub:
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("jhuwit/actisleep")

title: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: epoch-level activity data, use activity-based guider L5 apply SIB label. result one logical sleep label per epoch. raw X/Y/Z acceleration, acti_sleep_sib() calculates van Hees SIB indicator acti_sleep_ensemble() combines compatible guiders consensus label. example recording supplied actiread can used directly: result$labels retains one label per guider, result$fused contains consensus probability logical consensus label.
code: library(actisleep)  time <- as.POSIXct("2020-01-01 18:00:00", tz = "UTC") + 0:1439 * 60 epochs <- data.frame(   time = time,   activity = c(rep(20, 240), rep(0, 420), rep(20, 780)),   sib = c(rep(FALSE, 240), rep(TRUE, 420), rep(FALSE, 780)) )  guider <- acti_sleep_l5(epochs) epochs$sleep <- acti_sleep_label(epochs$sib, guider) head(epochs) #>                  time activity   sib sleep #> 1 2020-01-01 18:00:00       20 FALSE FALSE #> 2 2020-01-01 18:01:00       20 FALSE FALSE #> 3 2020-01-01 18:02:00       20 FALSE FALSE #> 4 2020-01-01 18:03:00       20 FALSE FALSE #> 5 2020-01-01 18:04:00       20 FALSE FALSE #> 6 2020-01-01 18:05:00       20 FALSE FALSE library(actiread)  raw <- actiread::acti_read_gt3x(   actiread::acti_example_gt3x(),   verbose = FALSE ) result <- acti_sleep_ensemble(raw, epoch = "5 seconds")  result$label_data

title: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: diary times available, create guider directly onset wake times. Times inclusive endpoints.
code: diary_window <- acti_sleep_diary(   epochs,   onset = as.POSIXct("2020-01-01 22:00:00", tz = "UTC"),   wakeup = as.POSIXct("2020-01-02 06:00:00", tz = "UTC") ) sum(diary_window$window) #> [1] 481

title: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: labelled, one-minute epochs, acti_sleep_tudor_locke() delegates Tudor–Locke period detection sleep metrics actigraph.sleepr. accepts usual actisleep column names: time, activity column, logical sleep/wake sleep column. Run diary helper separately person. diary one row per sleep interval, POSIXct onset wakeup columns; intervals can cross midnight span multiple days.
code: sleep_diary <- data.frame(   night = 1:2,   onset = as.POSIXct(c("2020-01-03 22:30:00", "2020-01-04 22:45:00"), tz = "UTC"),   wakeup = as.POSIXct(c("2020-01-04 06:15:00", "2020-01-05 06:30:00"), tz = "UTC") ) sleep_diary #>   night               onset              wakeup #> 1     1 2020-01-03 22:30:00 2020-01-04 06:15:00 #> 2     2 2020-01-04 22:45:00 2020-01-05 06:30:00  tudor_epochs <- acti_sleep_tudor_locke_diary(   data.frame(     time = as.POSIXct("2020-01-03 22:00:00", tz = "UTC") + 0:539 * 60,     activity = 0   ),   sleep_diary = sleep_diary ) tudor_locke <- acti_sleep_tudor_locke(tudor_epochs) tudor_locke[c("onset", "out_bed_time", "total_sleep_time", "efficiency")] #> # A tibble: 1 × 4 #>   onset               out_bed_time        total_sleep_time efficiency #>   <dttm>              <dttm>                         <int>      <dbl> #> 1 2020-01-03 22:30:00 2020-01-04 06:15:00              465        100

title: Create Sleep Measures of Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: acti_asleep() acti_sleeper() require complete, strictly time-ordered raw triaxial data. return columns: time, sleep, sleep_probability, sleep_stage, nonwear, method. models Python requirements managed upstream packages. sleeper, download model files first provide directory model_dir.
code: asleep_estimate <- acti_asleep(raw, verbose = FALSE) sleeper_estimate <- acti_sleeper(raw, model_dir = "path/to/sleeper-models")

what: Estimate sleep with the asleep model — acti_asleep
title: Estimate sleep with the asleep model — acti_asleep
text: Runs asleep::asleep() complete, time-ordered raw triaxial acceleration converts predictions common acti_sleep_estimate format.

title: Estimate sleep with the asleep model — acti_asleep
code: acti_asleep(   data,   min_wear_hours = 22L,   time_shift = "0",   report_light_and_temp = FALSE,   pytorch_device = c("cpu", "cuda:0"),   sample_rate = NULL,   verbose = TRUE,   force_download = FALSE )

title: Estimate sleep with the asleep model — acti_asleep
text: data data frame containing timestamps triaxial acceleration, readable accelerometry file path. File paths passed unchanged asleep::asleep(). min_wear_hours Minimum daily wear time used asleep summaries. time_shift Clock-time correction passed asleep::asleep(). report_light_and_temp Whether request light temperature output. pytorch_device Device used prediction. sample_rate Optional input sample rate. verbose Whether asleep prints progress messages. force_download Whether re-download asleep model files.

title: Estimate sleep with the asleep model — acti_asleep
text: acti_sleep_estimate tibble time, sleep, sleep_probability, sleep_stage, nonwear, method. asleep backend currently return probabilities, sleep_probability NA.

what: Run a sleep-label ensemble from raw or epoch data — acti_sleep_ensemble
title: Run a sleep-label ensemble from raw or epoch data — acti_sleep_ensemble
text: convenience workflow detects accepts sustained inactivity bouts, runs compatible sleep guiders, creates one sleep label per guider, produces consensus. Raw triaxial data use HDCZA, HorAngle, fixed 22:00–08:00 window default; L5 included data span requested duration. Epoch data use NotWorn fixed window, adding L5 possible. Set guiders choose subset explicitly.

title: Run a sleep-label ensemble from raw or epoch data — acti_sleep_ensemble
code: acti_sleep_ensemble(   data,   guiders = NULL,   epoch = "5 seconds",   sib_method = "vanHees2015",   fusion = c("staple", "majority"),   sleepwindow_type = c("SPT", "TimeInBed"),   ... )

title: Run a sleep-label ensemble from raw or epoch data — acti_sleep_ensemble
text: data Raw triaxial regular epoch-level data. Epoch data sib column conventional activity column. guiders Guider names. Defaults depend whether raw acceleration available. epoch Raw-data aggregation epoch. sib_method SIB method, passed acti_sleep_sib(). fusion Consensus rule: "staple" "majority". sleepwindow_type SPT TimeInBed overlap rule. ... Passed individual guider functions.

title: Run a sleep-label ensemble from raw or epoch data — acti_sleep_ensemble
text: list time-indexed data. epoch_data includes van Hees sib; guider label_data element time window; labels time plus one logical sleep_<guider> column per guider; fused time, probability, consensus label; label_data combines analysis columns.

title: Run a sleep-label ensemble from raw or epoch data — acti_sleep_ensemble
code: # \donttest{ raw <- actiread::acti_read_gt3x(actiread::acti_example_gt3x(), verbose = FALSE) result <- acti_sleep_ensemble(raw) # }

what: Fuse multiple sleep/wake labels with STAPLE — acti_sleep_fuse_labels
title: Fuse multiple sleep/wake labels with STAPLE — acti_sleep_fuse_labels
text: STAPLE estimates latent consensus sleep label input labeler's sensitivity specificity using expectation-maximisation.

title: Fuse multiple sleep/wake labels with STAPLE — acti_sleep_fuse_labels
code: acti_sleep_fuse_labels(   labels,   threshold = 0.5,   tolerance = 1e-06,   max_iterations = 200L )

title: Fuse multiple sleep/wake labels with STAPLE — acti_sleep_fuse_labels
text: labels data frame, matrix, tibble logical/binary sleep-label columns, output acti_sleep_labels(). threshold Posterior sleep-probability threshold fused label. tolerance, max_iterations STAPLE convergence controls.

title: Fuse multiple sleep/wake labels with STAPLE — acti_sleep_fuse_labels
text: tibble sleep_probability binary sleep columns. labels includes time epoch, index retained. fitted STAPLE parameters attached staple attribute.

title: Fuse multiple sleep/wake labels with STAPLE — acti_sleep_fuse_labels
code: labels <- data.frame(   sleep_l5 = c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),   sleep_fixed = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE) ) acti_sleep_fuse_labels(labels) #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   sleep_probability sleep #>               <dbl> <lgl> #> 1      0.0000000924 FALSE #> 2      1.000        TRUE  #> 3      0.375        FALSE #> 4      0.0000000924 FALSE

what: Dispatch a sleep-period-time guider from data — acti_sleep_guider
title: Dispatch a sleep-period-time guider from data — acti_sleep_guider
text: "HDCZA" "HorAngle", supply raw triaxial acceleration; selected function derives regular epoch-level posture angle. remaining methods use regular epoch-level activity, SIB, timestamp data. Use acti_sleep_guider_requirements() method--method summary.

title: Dispatch a sleep-period-time guider from data — acti_sleep_guider
code: acti_sleep_guider(   data,   method = c("HDCZA", "HorAngle", "L5", "setwindow", "HLRB", "NotWorn", "sleeplog"),   ... )

title: Dispatch a sleep-period-time guider from data — acti_sleep_guider
text: data raw epoch-level data frame, according method. method One "HDCZA", "HorAngle", "L5", "setwindow", "HLRB", "NotWorn", "sleeplog". ... Method-specific arguments, threshold, start_hour, onset, wakeup.

title: Dispatch a sleep-period-time guider from data — acti_sleep_guider
text: acti_sleep_guider object.

title: Dispatch a sleep-period-time guider from data — acti_sleep_guider
code: data <- actimetrics::acti_count_data data <- data[rep(seq_len(nrow(data)), length.out = 24 * 60), ] data$time <- data$time[1] + (seq_len(nrow(data)) - 1) * 60 guider <- acti_sleep_guider(data, method = "L5")
